rows.question: Do I need an appointment for the emergency department?
rows.answer: No. Emergency is open every hour of the year and works on clinical triage, not appointments. Come straight in.

rows.question: Which insurance companies are you empanelled with?
rows.answer: We are empanelled with all major TPAs and with Swasthya Sathi. Bring your card and a photo ID to the insurance desk on the ground floor.

rows.question: Can I book a doctor’s appointment online?
rows.answer: Yes — use the booking form on the contact page, or call reception. You will get a confirmation call within two working hours.

rows.question: What are the visiting hours?
rows.answer: General wards: 5pm to 7pm daily. ICU: one attendant, 6pm to 6.30pm. Maternity has its own arrangement — ask the ward sister.

rows.question: Is treatment started before payment?
rows.answer: Yes. Emergency treatment begins before any payment discussion. The billing desk comes to you afterwards.

rows.question: Do you offer home sample collection?
rows.answer: For most routine blood tests, yes, within Bardhaman town. Book by phone before 9am for a same-day visit.

rows.question: Where can I park?
rows.answer: There is free parking for sixty cars behind the main block, with an ambulance-only lane at the front entrance.
